capture_statuses.official_captured: Value or qualitative disclosure is directly supported by an official source excerpt.
capture_statuses.partial: Official source contains relevant disclosure but does not fully resolve the field.
capture_statuses.not_disclosed_in_release: Official release/exhibit was reviewed and did not disclose this field; this is a closed field for that source, not a missing fetch.
capture_statuses.not_applicable: Field is not applicable to this issuer/source context and must include rationale.
capture_statuses.manual_required: No validated official-source capture exists yet; downstream confidence must remain degraded.
capture_statuses.not_fetched: Source candidate is known or expected but has not been fetched/captured.
capture_statuses.missing_metadata: Required source metadata is absent from the local inventory and must be repaired before capture can be considered complete.

adjusted_eps.description: Company-reported adjusted/non-GAAP EPS or explicit not-disclosed state.
adjusted_eps.freshness_rule: latest reported quarter or current earnings release cycle

guidance.description: Company-issued outlook/guidance, including explicit no-guidance/not-disclosed state.
guidance.freshness_rule: latest reported quarter, current fiscal-year outlook, or stated forward period

growth_bridge.description: Revenue/growth bridge, key drivers, organic growth, FX, price/volume, or comparable decomposition when officially disclosed.
growth_bridge.freshness_rule: latest reported quarter or year-to-date management bridge

segment_margins.description: Reported segment margin, operating margin, or equivalent segment profitability disclosures.
segment_margins.freshness_rule: latest reported quarter or year-to-date official segment table/commentary

orders_backlog.description: Orders, backlog, book-to-bill, remaining performance obligations, or explicit not-disclosed state.
orders_backlog.freshness_rule: latest reported quarter; do not substitute stale annual backlog for current-quarter silence without status=partial and note.

management_explanation.description: Official management explanation of quarter drivers, demand, risks, or outlook from release, exhibit, presentation, or transcript.

acquisition_debt_notes.description: Material official notes on acquisitions, divestitures, leverage, debt issuance/maturity, buybacks, or capital allocation relevant to thesis/risk.
acquisition_debt_notes.freshness_rule: latest earnings cycle plus any current official financing/acquisition disclosure
